metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2024 · Attack on Titan: The Last Attack
metas.description: The fate of the world hangs in the balance as Eren unleashes the ultimate power of the Titans. With a burning determination to eliminate all who threaten Eldia, he leads an unstoppable army of Colossal Titans towards Marley.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2023 · Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · Mahavatar Narsimha
metas.description: The demon Hiranyakashyap seeks revenge on Vishnu and declares himself a god. His son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu. Vishnu manifests as Narsimha to defeat the demon and restore balance.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2021 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Tsuzumi Mansion Arc
metas.description: Tanjiro ventures to the south-southeast where he encounters a cowardly young man named Zenitsu Agatsuma. He is a fellow survivor from Final Selection and his sparrow asks Tanjiro to help keep him in line.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
metas.description: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2020 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Movie: Mugen Train
metas.description: After his family was brutally murdered and his sister turned into a demon, Tanjiro Kamado's journey as a demon slayer began. Tanjiro and his comrades embark on a new mission aboard the Mugen Train, on track to despair.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · The Wild Robot
metas.description: A sentient robot stranded on an uninhabited island raises an orphaned gosling while trying to fit in with the local wildlife.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2020 · Soul
metas.description: Joe is a middle-school band teacher whose life hasn't quite gone the way he expected. His true passion is jazz. But when he travels to another realm to help someone find their passion, he soon discovers what it means to have soul.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2020 · Wolfwalkers
metas.description: A young apprentice hunter and her father journey to Ireland to help wipe out the last wolf pack. But everything changes when she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.
